reports.name: Stem, Inc.
reports.headline: Stem, Inc. (NYSE: STEM) — Arun Narayanan's Software Pivot: From Hardware Reseller to AI-Driven Energy Dispatch Platform, Athena's Rebirth as PowerTrack, and the Race to Recurring Revenue Amid a Stressed Balance Sheet
reports.subtitle: Spent its first decade as an aggregator of commercial and industrial battery energy storage systems, building a proprietary AI dispatch engine called Athena to maximize value for behind-the-meter assets.
reports.abstract: Stem, Inc. spent its first decade as an aggregator of commercial and industrial battery energy storage systems, building a proprietary AI dispatch engine called Athena to maximize value for behind-the-meter assets. That model worked at small scale but collapsed when the company over-indexed on hardware resale margins in 2021–2023, ballooning revenues to $461 million by FY2023 while generating deep operating losses and accumulating a $1.6 billion deficit. The reckoning arrived in 2024: interconnection delays, USDA funding lags, and deliberate strategy reset caused revenues to crater 69 percent
